title: Age and Occupation Consistency
description: Checks if the age corresponds logically with the occupation. For example, a 'Schülerin / Schüler' should not be older than typical school age.
detection_logic: if beruf == 'Schülerin / Schüler' and int(alter) < 2005: flag as violation

title: Age Format Validity
description: Ensures that the age column contains either a valid year or 'keine Angabe'.
detection_logic: if alter not in ['keine Angabe'] and not alter.isdigit(): flag as violation

title: Gender and Occupation Consistency
description: Checks for logical consistency between gender and occupation, e.g., 'Studentin / Student' should not have a gender of 'unbekannt'.
detection_logic: if beruf == 'Studentin / Student' and geschlecht == 'unbekannt': flag as violation

title: Consumption Frequency and Alcohol Preference
description: Checks for consistency between consumption frequency and preference for alcohol-free beer. Frequent consumers should not have a high preference for alcohol-free beer.
detection_logic: if konsumhaeufigkeit in ['mehrmals pro Woche', 'täglich'] and praef_sorte_alkoholfrei > 3: flag as violation

title: Region Specification
description: Ensures that if 'bundesland' is 'nicht in Deutschland', other location-specific fields should not be specified.
detection_logic: if bundesland == 'nicht in Deutschland' and beruf != 'keine Angabe': flag as violation

title: Involvement and Importance Consistency
description: Checks if involvement in a role is consistent with the importance of the role.
detection_logic: if involvement_rolle > involvement_wichtigkeit: flag as violation

title: Health Importance and Alcohol Avoidance
description: Checks if a high importance on health correlates with a high importance on alcohol avoidance.
detection_logic: if gesundheit_wichtig > 3 and alkoholverzicht_wichtig < 3: flag as violation

title: Preference for Alcohol-Free and Alcoholic Beers
description: Ensures that a high preference for alcohol-free beer does not coincide with a high preference for alcoholic beer.
detection_logic: if praef_sorte_alkoholfrei > 3 and praef_bier_alkohol > 3: flag as violation

title: Environmental Importance and Bio Premium Willingness
description: Checks if a high importance on environmental friendliness correlates with a willingness to pay more for bio products.
detection_logic: if umweltfreundlich_wichtig > 3 and bio_mehrpreis_bereit < 3: flag as violation

title: Taste Influence Consistency
description: Ensures that the influence of taste is consistently rated higher than other influences such as price or packaging.
detection_logic: if einfluss_geschmack < max(einfluss_preis, einfluss_verpackungsdesign): flag as violation
